description: This file defines multiple EventSource classes for logging and diagnostics within the Orleans runtime, including callback data, outside runtime client, dispatcher, inside runtime client, and incoming message agent events.

classes.name: OrleansCallBackDataEvent
classes.description: EventSource for callback data events, including timeout, target silo failure, callback completion, and cancellation.

classes.name: OrleansOutsideRuntimeClientEvent
classes.description: EventSource for outside runtime client events such as sending requests, receiving responses, and sending responses.

classes.name: OrleansDispatcherEvent
classes.description: EventSource for dispatcher events, primarily receiving messages.

classes.name: OrleansInsideRuntimeClientEvent
classes.description: EventSource for inside runtime client events, including sending requests, receiving responses, and sending responses.

classes.name: OrleansIncomingMessageAgentEvent
classes.description: EventSource for incoming message agent events, primarily receiving messages.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Logs a timeout event for a message.

methods.name: OnTargetSiloFail
methods.description: Logs a target silo failure event.
